issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: allium, polished_andesite, cauldron, andesite_wall.

notes.artefacts: two of Carlton's three notes (bigger, different flowers) are not addressed; L3 barely differs from L2

visual.summary: Level 3 is L2 with a leafy pergola over one corner: hard to tell apart from L2, and still all poppies.
problems: Carlton asked for different flowers: the beds are all red poppies. Mix 4 or 5 kinds (cornflower, allium, oxeye daisy, azure bluet, red and orange tulips, lilac or rose bush as tall flowers) in rows per bed
Carlton asked for it to be bigger: it is still about 9 x 9. Go to 11 x 11 or 13 x 13 with more beds or a centre feature
Make L3 clearly different from L2 (Carlton asks this on every structure): an arch of leaves over the path, a bird bath or fountain in the middle, a bee nest, a scarecrow

It now stands on a one-block cobblestone plinth with a stair step, which fixes the sinking. Check that Carlton is happy with a raised plinth; a garden floor level with the grass (beds edged by logs or a low fence) would look more natural

problems: To set L3 further apart from L2 (Carlton's note on other structures): a bee nest in the cherry, a small pond or a bird bath on one side

Layer 0 is now level with the grass (meta.groundLayer 0): in game the builders never dig or replace ground, so the mod side still has to support setting paths and beds into the lawn before this can be built as drawn
